tools.name: calculate_nhl_tax
tools.description: Calculate professional-athlete tax for one NHL season with the Jock Taxes engine. Ask the user for a missing team or salary. Do not invent team codes, seasons, salaries, or filing status. Call list_tax_calculator_inputs for allowed values. Send salary when the user has one season total taxed entirel

tools.name: equivalent_nhl_salary
tools.description: Find the gross salary on a comparison NHL team that matches the after-tax income of a known salary on a baseline team. Ask for the baseline team, comparison team, filing status, and either baseline_salary or base_salary. Do not invent team codes. Call list_tax_calculator_inputs for allowed values. P

tools.name: player_movement_nhl
tools.description: Compare after-tax income when a NHL player moves from one team to another at the same gross pay. Ask for the origin team, destination team, filing status, and either gross_salary or base_salary. Do not invent team codes. Call list_tax_calculator_inputs for allowed values. Present the result as a cal

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.
